svg.title: How origin cell scores are aggregated to district level using population weighting
svg.desc: Three-panel diagram. Top panel shows multiple origin cells inside a district polygon, each with a population weight and a score. Middle panel shows the population-weighted mean formula. Bottom panel lists all six district-level metrics produced.
svg.text: Each raster cell carries a population weight and its own scores
district score = Σ (scoreᵢ × popᵢ) / Σ popᵢ
Non-finite values and zero-weight cells are excluded before averaging
